name: Pipe Velocity Calculator
description: Calculate fluid velocity in a pipe from flow rate and pipe diameter.

seo.title: Pipe Velocity Calculator - Fluid Flow
seo.description: Pipe Velocity Calculator — Calculate fluid velocity in a pipe from flow rate and pipe diameter with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: v = Q / A where A = π(D/2)². Flow rate in m³/s, diameter in m, result in m/s. Typical liquid velocity: 1-3 m/s.

content.introduction: Calculate fluid velocity inside a pipe. For liquid lines, recommended velocity is 1-3 m/s; for gas lines, 10-30 m/s; for suction lines, under 1.5 m/s to avoid cavitation.

example.description: 100 m³/h through 150mm pipe gives 1.57 m/s velocity.

faq.q: What is a good pipe velocity for water?
faq.a: 1-2 m/s for general water service, 0.5-1.5 m/s for pump suction, and up to 3 m/s for short discharge runs.
Too high causes erosion, noise, and high pressure drop. Too low means oversized pipe and higher cost, plus sediment deposition in slurry service.
